description.value: Panorama Mountain Resort is a self-contained alpine village nestled in the BC Kootenay Rockies, offering ski-in/ski-out accommodation alongside a full range of summer mountain biking activities. The compact village puts restaurants, pubs, cafés, equipment rentals and hot pools steps from guest rooms, making it a rare all-in-one destination in a remote mountain setting. It ranks in the top 10 in North America by vertical drop and draws both winter and summer adventure travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, large mountain resort in BC's Kootenay Rockies with accommodation ('three types of accommodation'), on-site restaurants and pubs, and mountain biking infrastructure including 'Bike Lessons' and 'Equipment Rentals, Tuning & Repairs'. However, the website content contains no explicit mention of secure overnight bike storage, staff bike-handling procedures, laundry, drying room, e-bike charging, or most other WWC amenities — only nearby evening food can be confirmed from the village dining description. The phone and website URL match OSM tags; the address is not explicitly confirmed in the fetched text.
concerns: Neither secure bike storage nor staff bike-handling procedure is mentioned anywhere on the website; both required criteria are unverifiable from available evidence.
Phone number in OSM (+1-250-342-6941) not explicitly surfaced in fetched website text — could not cross-confirm.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The resort is a legitimate and active BC accommodation with mountain biking infrastructure, but the website provides no evidence for either required WWC criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure). Direct confirmation via phone or property visit is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Resort operates year-round with a dedicated mountain biking programme (bike lessons, equipment rentals/tuning). A direct enquiry to the resort would likely resolve both required criteria quickly.
